connector.name: Alibaba Cloud DashScope - Qwen
connector.registryDescription: Alibaba Cloud DashScope MCP: Qwen chat, embeddings, and model discovery on your own account.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package alibaba-cloud-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the nirholas account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: DASHSCOPE_API_KEY
env.description: DashScope API key. Create one at https://bailian.console.alibabacloud.com/ → API Keys.

env.name: DASHSCOPE_MODEL_ID
env.description: Default chat model id. Options: qwen-max, qwen-plus (default), qwen-turbo, qwen-long.

env.name: DASHSCOPE_EMBED_MODEL_ID
env.description: Default embedding model id. Defaults to text-embedding-v3.

env.name: DASHSCOPE_BASE_URL
env.description: Custom DashScope endpoint. Defaults to international (dashscope-intl.aliyuncs.com).

env.name: DASHSCOPE_REGION
env.description: Set to 'cn' to use the China endpoint (dashscope.aliyuncs.com). Ignored if DASHSCOPE_BASE_URL is set.
